name: Water Pouch Bounty
summary: Spigot Operator Luglunket greets you again, hoping you carry five more Wastewander water pouches, and keeping a care package ready.

sections.title: Back Again
sections.body: After Water Pouch Bounty, Luglunket welcomes you back and asks whether five more Wastewander water pouches are in your pack. If so, a care package is already set aside with your name on it.

sections.title: Keep Them Coming
sections.body: Luglunket is pleased with the pouches reclaimed, since each one keeps everyone further from disaster. Luglunket promises to make it worth your while for every five pouches you bring.

faq.answer: Luglunket, the spigot operator in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: How many water pouches are needed?
faq.answer: Five Wastewander water pouches, the same as before.
A care package, held for you by name.
It follows the earlier Water Pouch Bounty, in which you first brought pouches to Luglunket.
